props.body: Ground Level Contracting is a commercial excavation and civil infrastructure company based in Barrie, Ontario. We serve project managers and site supervisors across Barrie, Midland, Orillia, Innisfil, Wasaga Beach, and all of Simcoe County. We specialize in preparing land for development — solving complex geotechnical challenges efficiently and safely so your build proceeds on schedule and on budget. With 15+ years of field experience and 500+ commercial projects completed, our licensed and insured crews are built for the complexity and accountability that B2B construction relationships demand.

props.intro: Ground Level Contracting handles civil and site work from first cut to final grade — Barrie, Midland, Orillia, Innisfil, Wasaga Beach, and Simcoe County. Commercial GCs and owners bring us in when schedules are fixed, soils are variable, and handoffs between trades cannot slip. We coordinate excavation, utility trenching, structural digs, grading certificates, foundation cuts, drainage installs, hardscape transitions, hauling corridors, and seasonal snow contracts under one dispatch standard so your superintendent has a single accountable crew lead. Our field teams document trench depths, spoils handling, and inspection sign-offs as work progresses — not after the fact — because municipal reviewers and structural engineers expect traceable decisions when groundwater, frost, or unexpected ledge appears. Whether you are opening a greenfield commercial pad, correcting a subdivision lot, retrofitting storm capacity, or staging logistics for a multi-phase industrial build, we align equipment selection, haul routes, and daily sequencing with your concrete pour dates, crane picks, and envelope trades. Licensed, insured, and mobilized for Simcoe County’s heaviest commercial calendars, we quote transparent scopes, stick to agreed production rates, and communicate the same day when conditions demand a field adjustment. When winter hits, commercial lots still need reliable plowing and salting so tenants and trucks keep moving without liability gaps. Ask us for references, insurance certificates, WSIB clearance, bonded coverage where required, and past commercial schedules matched to your risk profile on request. Use the service lines below to drill into scope, typical deliverables, inspection expectations, and how we coordinate with your site team before equipment ever rolls onto the property or traffic control changes on your corridor.

servicesTileGrid.intro: Each tile is a live photo from our work: open any line for scope, then hit the yellow button to go straight to that service hub or call dispatch.
panelCopy: Cut-to-fill, trenching, and mass grading for commercial pads—mobilization, spoils strategy, and engineer tie-ins documented for inspection.
Finish grading, compaction, and drainage tie-ins that set up foundations and hardscape—survey-aware tolerances and storm-ready surfaces.
Footings, walls, pits, and civil tie-ins with pour-day discipline—forming, reinforcing, and backfill sequencing aligned to geotech.
Storm, foundation, and hardscape water management with armor stone, walls, and permeable details in one integrated scope.
Export, import, clearing, and site logistics with truck-matched scheduling—clean gates, scale tickets, and placement control.
Commercial-only snow and ice—SLA language, GPS-tracked passes, and salting plans for plazas, yards, and institutional sites.

props.body: Simcoe County geology — rock, clay, high water table — eliminates underprepared contractors. GLC mobilizes commercial-grade equipment, licensed operators, and the project coordination depth that tight commercial timelines demand.

reasons.title: Rapid Site Mobilization
reasons.text: Equipment and crews reach any Simcoe County site within hours of call. When your pour date is fixed, we're on-site — no extended lead times, no delays.

reasons.title: Geotechnical Field Depth
reasons.text: Rock, clay, and high water table are our daily realities. We diagnose site conditions before they become change orders and adapt in the field — not on a call with the office.

reasons.title: Direct Project Manager Line
reasons.text: One number. Same-day updates, clean documentation, and sign-offs that keep your project files tight. We speak GC and PM fluently — no coordination gaps.

reasons.title: Single-Source Scope Control
reasons.text: Excavation, septic & utility digs, foundations, drainage, clearing, hauling — one contractor across all scopes. Fewer handoffs, tighter coordination, one number to call.

steps.title: Site Consultation
steps.desc: Call or email us with your site address, scope, and timeline. We review ground conditions and site constraints, then provide a clear assessment — no vague estimates.

steps.title: Detailed Quote
steps.desc: We deliver transparent, itemized pricing with no hidden costs. Every line item is confirmed before any equipment moves — because your project budget matters as much as your schedule.

steps.title: Crew Mobilization
steps.desc: Our operators and equipment mobilize to your Barrie, Midland, Orillia, or Simcoe County site efficiently. Safety protocols are locked in on day one, and your site super has a direct line to our crew lead.

steps.title: Delivery & Signoff
steps.desc: Work is completed to spec, all site documentation is delivered, and signoff is confirmed. Your concrete pour, framing, or next trade can proceed on schedule — that's the Ground Level guarantee.
